filter.health_condition: Recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (RDEB) patient with chronic infected wounds

projects.intervention_detail: Investigator-compounded low-dose calcipotriol ointment (0.05 ug/g) applied daily for four weeks to a chronic leg wound of one 75-year-old DDEB patient.

papers.title: Low-dose calcipotriol can elicit wound closure, anti-microbial, and anti-neoplastic effects in epidermolysis bullosa keratinocytes.
